_comment: Editorial artifact per the Observer Station spec: maps ISO3 country codes to west/east bloc alignment for classifying South Africa's export partners. Everything not listed defaults to nonaligned, then split into africa/other by continent (see AFRICA_ISO3 in pipeline.py, a fixed geographic fact rather than a political judgment call). This file IS a political judgment call -- version it, and note in a journal entry if a country is ever reclassified, since that rewrites the export_split history series.
